target: six keys and six actual drawn bridges per character; preserve approved identity and camera

keypose_observations.observation: Clip begins after full windup, with pitcher already in stride/landing; torso angled.
Pitching arm acceleration near the release phase; no precise release-time or joint measurement.
Forward torso follow-through, rear leg lifted behind lead support leg.
Pitcher remains forward over lead support leg during recovery.
Camera turns with play; pitcher partly outside view. No further pitcher pose inference.
